description: Post-F4B set from three previously unused, openly downloadable ACL Anthology papers. It was frozen before retrieval/generation and is now a development-regression set after its generation trace was audited.
reclassification_reason: Phase G generation contexts were inspected and exposed a mismatch with the offline retrieval proxy; this set must not be used as unseen confirmation after failure-guided fixes.
freeze_policy: The original questions, gold answers, required facts, and aliases remain frozen. After reclassification, this set may be used for development regression only; any final confirmation requires a new unseen set.
